items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: His name -- well, George [Gillam] was one. He was a trumpet player

ctx.x: If they didn't, you could put a deaf ear and forget it, you know, you say well, no, that's not what I'm --
Do you remember anyone from these other traveling shows that impressed you that you got something from?

Yes. I'm trying to think now. His name -- well, George [Gillam] was one. He was a trumpet player and he -- big old young boy. He'd take -- be playing a march, or anything. If you felt like it, he'd raise it an octave higher. And never miss a note. Psssss, psssss, pssssss, everybody'd be looking and listening, he'd blow. He was from Carolina. I'm trying to think now, Spartanburg?
